name: Grain of rice
headline: length
subtitle: Long-grain rice kernel (brown rice, after hulling)
description: Rice kernels are sorted into length classes, and long-grain varieties have long, slender kernels. The International Rice Research Institute's Standard Evaluation System classes a hulled brown-rice kernel as long when it measures 6.6 to 7.5 millimetres. Kernels over 7.5 mm count as extra long, while medium grains run 5.51 to 6.6 mm.

measures.label: Kernel length (long-grain class)
measures.note: IRRI 'Long' class for brown rice length, measured after dehulling and before milling

facts.text: IRRI's length classes for brown rice are extra long (more than 7.5 mm), long (6.6 to 7.5 mm), medium (5.51 to 6.6 mm) and short (5.5 mm or less).
Kernels are called slender when their length is more than 3 times their width.

sources.publisher: International Rice Research Institute (IRRI) Rice Knowledge Bank
sources.title: Standard Evaluation System for Rice (SES)

caveats: The range is IRRI's long-grain class for brown rice (hulled, before milling); milled white rice was not measured by this source.
No USDA figure for kernel length was found, so the IRRI scale is used instead.
No primary source giving the mass of a single long-grain kernel was found, so mass is left out.
